tables.name: gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly
tables.purpose: Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value.
tables.sql:
create or replace table gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly as
with months as (
  select distinct last_day(valuation_date) as month_end from valuation_observations
),
live as (
  select
    v.portfolio_id,
    v.instrument_id,
    v.valuation_date,
    v.received_at,
    v.value_amount,
    v.valuation_type,
    v.approval_status,
    v.supersedes_valuation_id
  from valuation_observations v
  where not exists (select 1 from valuation_observations x where x.supersedes_valuation_id = v.id)
    and v.approval_status <> 'rejected' and v.value_amount <> 0
  union all
  select
    s.portfolio_id,
    s.instrument_id,
    s.position_date,
    s.received_at,
    s.source_market_value,
    'administrator',
    'approved',
    null
  from position_snapshots s
  join instruments i on i.id = s.instrument_id
  where i.instrument_type <> 'cash' and s.view_type = 'investment'
    and not exists (select 1 from position_snapshots x where x.supersedes_position_id = s.id)
    and not exists (select 1 from valuation_observations v where v.portfolio_id = s.portfolio_id and v.value_amount <> 0)
),
as_at as (
  select
    m.month_end,
    v.*,
    row_number() over (partition by m.month_end, v.portfolio_id, v.instrument_id order by v.valuation_date desc, v.received_at desc) as rn
  from months m
  join live v on v.valuation_date <= m.month_end
)
select
  date_trunc('month', a.month_end)::date as report_month,
  e.entity_name as entity,
  i.canonical_name as holding,
  a.value_amount as net_worth_usd,
  a.value_amount * (
    select o.value from market_observations o
    where o.series_key = 'FX:USDSGD:WMR_4PM' and o.observed_at <= a.month_end + interval 1 day
    order by o.observed_at desc limit 1
  ) as net_worth_sgd,
  case
    when a.valuation_type = 'manager_estimate' then 'estimated'
    when a.approval_status in ('pending', 'proposed') then 'unverified'
    when a.supersedes_valuation_id is not null then 'revised'
    else 'official'
  end as status
from as_at a
join portfolios p on p.id = a.portfolio_id
join legal_entities e on e.id = p.legal_entity_id
join instruments i on i.id = a.instrument_id
where a.rn = 1

tables.name: gold_investment_report_cash_daily
tables.purpose: Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view.
tables.sql:
create or replace table gold_investment_report_cash_daily as
select
  s.position_date,
  e.entity_name as entity,
  s.view_type,
  s.source_market_value as cash_usd,
  s.data_status as status
from position_snapshots s
join portfolios p on p.id = s.portfolio_id
join legal_entities e on e.id = p.legal_entity_id
join instruments i on i.id = s.instrument_id
where i.instrument_type = 'cash'
  and not exists (select 1 from position_snapshots x where x.supersedes_position_id = s.id)

tables.name: gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly
tables.sql: create or replace table gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly as with pv as (select date_trunc('month', valuation_date) as month, sum(value_amount) as portfolio_value from valuation_observations where valuation_type <> 'manager_estimate' and id not in (select supersedes_valuation_id from valuation_observations where supersedes_valuation_id is not null) group by 1), pr as (select month, portfolio_value / lag(portfolio_value) over (order by month) - 1 as portfolio_return from pv), lv as (select series_key, date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', observed_at)) as month, max_by(value, observed_at) as level from market_observations where observation_type = 'index_level' and id not in (select supersedes_observation_id from market_observations where supersedes_observation_id is not null) group by 1, 2), ir as (select series_key, month, level / lag(level) over (partition by series_key order by month) - 1 as index_return from lv), bd as (select id, benchmark_code from benchmark_definitions as d where approval_status = 'approved' and version_number = (select max(version_number) from benchmark_definitions as x where x.benchmark_code = d.benchmark_code and x.approval_status = 'approved')), br as (select bd.benchmark_code, i.month, sum(c.component_weight * (i.index_return + coalesce(c.spread_bps, 0) / 10000 / 12)) as benchmark_return from ir as i join benchmark_components as c on c.market_series_key = i.series_key join bd on bd.id = c.benchmark_definition_id where i.month between c.weight_effective_from and coalesce(c.weight_effective_to, date '9999-12-31') group by 1, 2) select br.benchmark_code, pr.month, pr.portfolio_return, br.benchmark_return, pr.portfolio_return - br.benchmark_return as difference from pr join br on br.month = pr.month
tables.purpose: Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values.
